news.title: 3 arrested after shooting on Wilcoxen Street in Newnan, police say
news.summary: Three Newnan men face aggravated assault charges after a shooting on Saturday left bullet holes in nearby homes and led police to firearms and drugs, according to the Newnan Police Department.

news.title: Father speaks after son killed in shooting at Norfolk Southern site
news.summary: A man who witnesses said had just arrived for work was shot and killed Monday night in the employee parking lot of a Norfolk Southern intermodal facility in Austell.

news.title: Georgia death row inmate’s request for clemency denied; execution scheduled
news.summary: Stacey Ian Humphreys was convicted in the 2003 murders of Cobb County real estate agents Cyndi Williams and Lori Brown.

news.title: Atlanta driver leads troopers on multi-county chase down GA 400
news.summary: A high-speed pursuit involving a stolen vehicle ended Tuesday morning when the driver crashed into a dump truck at a Forsyth County intersection, according to law enforcement.

news.title: Student found with weapon at Fulton County high school
news.summary: A weapon was confiscated from a student at a Fulton County high school campus Tuesday, according to school officials.

news.title: 41-year-old man seriously injured in Cobb County crash, police say
news.summary: A 41-year-old man was seriously injured in a crash involving three vehicles in Cobb County on Monday afternoon, according to police.

news.title: DNA match links Florida convict to 2016 DeKalb kidnapping, assault
news.summary: A 42-year-old man was extradited to DeKalb County after a grand jury indicted him on charges of rape, aggravated sodomy and kidnapping in connection with a 2016 cold case.

news.title: Norfolk Southern contractor dies after shooting near railway property in Austell, officials say
news.summary: The incident happened just outside the Norfolk Southern property located at 6000 Dr. Luke Glenn Jr. Memorial Highway.

news.title: 22-year-old caregiver arrested after 3-year-old found wandering in Marietta, police say
news.summary: Warrants indicate that she did not realize the child was missing for about 30 minutes.

news.title: Georgia death row inmate has clemency hearing today, with other legal challenges ongoing before execution scheduled for tomorrow
news.summary: It's unclear how likely any path would give a reprieve to Stacey Humphreys, who was convicted of killing two women in Cobb County in 2003.
